title: Atlassian - Issues with 403 user authentication errors across Atlassian products
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: Issues with 403 user authentication errors across Atlassian products
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2025-03-04T07:31:46.043Z
Resolved: 2025-03-04T07:31:46.088Z
Updates:
- 2025-03-04T07:31:46.088Z: resolved - We are aware of an issue that was impacting user authentication to Atlassian services between 6:10AM Tuesday 4th March UTC and 6:35AM Tuesday 4th March UTC.
Users that were already logged in would not have been impacted by this issue.
A deployment suspected of causing this issue was rolled back and the problem was subsequently resolved.
